resources.string: A 3D printing slicer for Android. It slices models with the OrcaSlicer engine and its printer and filament profiles.

See the license text for more details.

Orcinus uses the OrcaSlicer engine. OrcaSlicer is based on Bambu Studio by Bambu Lab, Bambu Studio on PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research, and PrusaSlicer on Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci and the RepRap community.
The libraries, engine and font the app is built from, and their licenses
